steps.text: Filter the AP Queue to Pending and take the oldest invoice
Check the vendor exists in the Vendor Master
If the vendor is consignment, reconcile against the Consignment Statement tab instead of a PO; otherwise three-way match PO, GRN and invoice
Compare vendor, amount and items with the last 10 days' invoices before approving
Above ₹50,000, get the Finance Controller's second approval; after a CFO line-stoppage email for a critical vendor, approve and note FC approval afterwards
Set the status and email the AP Lead for anything on hold
